family.description: This family of proteins is functionally uncharacterised. This family This entry represents a novel family of serine proteases (BubE) that function in bacterial ubiquitination-like (Bub) pathways. BubE proteins contain a conserved serine-histidine catalytic dyad that can cleave both peptide and isopeptide bonds. The proteins also contain a conserved C4 zinc finger motif formed by four cysteine residues. BubE appears to negatively regulate Bub activity by cleaving ubiquitin-like protein-target conjugates. The proteins often contain hydrophobic N- or C-terminal extensions that may mediate association with membranes. BubE proteins are found in both Type I and Type II Bub operons, which encode components of bacterial protein conjugation systems that function through unusual oxyester intermediates.
family.name: Bacterial ubiquitination-like system serine protease (BubE)
